About UsVirtue Intelligence GmbH is an internationally operating technology company headquartered in Darmstadt, Germany. We specialize in electronic components, semiconductors, Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, industrial networking, and embedded systems.By combining international sourcing capabilities, technical expertise, and strong partnerships with manufacturers and development teams, we provide electronic components and customized technology solutions to customers across Germany and Europe.To support our continued business expansion, we are seeking an experienced and results-driven Technical Sales & Business Development Manager.The primary focus of this role is to develop our electronic components and semiconductor business, while actively expanding our customer base and identifying new opportunities in IoT solutions and industrial networking products.Key Responsibilities1. Sales & Business Development- Identify and acquire new customers across Germany and Europe, particularly OEMs, ODMs, EMS providers, system integrators, and industrial manufacturers.- Develop and maintain long-term customer relationships and strategic accounts.- Drive sales of electronic components, including semiconductors, integrated circuits (ICs), active and passive components, connectors, and related products.- Actively develop new customers and business opportunities for IoT devices, embedded systems, and industrial networking solutions.- Promote industrial Ethernet switches, industrial routers, 4G/5G communication devices, asset trackers, sensors, and customized hardware solutions.- Identify potential customers in industrial automation, logistics, telecommunications, smart infrastructure, and other relevant industries.- Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and customer inquiries to quotations, negotiations, and contract closure.- Achieve agreed revenue, gross margin, and business development targets.2. Electronic Components Sales & Customer Support- Manage customer inquiries, Requests for Quotation (RFQs), Bills of Materials (BOMs), and component sourcing requirements.- Prepare competitive quotations and negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, and commercial terms.- Support customers in sourcing hard-to-find, shortage, and end-of-life (EOL) components.- Identify design-in opportunities and provide technical and commercial support during component selection.- Collaborate with international manufacturers, distributors, and supply partners.- Identify cross-selling opportunities and expand business with existing customers.- Support customers throughout the entire purchasing process, from initial inquiry to successful delivery.3. Product Management & Technical Solutions- Support the management and development of selected product portfolios, including electronic components, IoT devices, and industrial networking products.- Identify new products and technologies based on customer requirements, market trends, and business opportunities.- Evaluate manufacturer and partner solutions regarding technical suitability, commercial competitiveness, and market potential.- Support technical discussions, product selection, design-in activities, and customized hardware development.- Define product requirements in collaboration with customers, engineering teams, and development partners.- Contribute to product roadmaps, business cases, pricing strategies, and go-to-market activities.- Support new product introductions and product lifecycle management.4. International Supplier & Project Coordination- Establish and maintain relationships with international manufacturers, distributors, and technology partners.- Coordinate product specifications, pricing, availability, delivery schedules, and technical requirements.- Act as an interface between customers, suppliers, engineering teams, purchasing, and logistics.- Support customer-specific development projects and technical evaluations.- Coordinate IoT and industrial networking projects from initial requirements through product delivery.- Assist in resolving technical, quality-related, and supply chain issues.5. Market Analysis & Strategic Business Development- Monitor market trends, technology developments, pricing, and competitive activities in the electronics industry.- Identify emerging opportunities in electronic components, IoT, and industrial communication markets.- Explore potential new product categories, suppliers, and strategic partnerships.- Develop sales strategies and support go-to-market plans for new products and solutions.- Represent Virtue Intelligence at trade fairs, industry exhibitions, and customer events.- Maintain accurate customer information, sales opportunities, and project records in CRM systems.- Prepare regular sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and business development reports.Qualifications & RequirementsProfessional Qualifications- Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least three years of professional experience in electronic component sales, semiconductor distribution, technical sales, or business development.- Proven experience in new customer acquisition and B2B relationship development.- Solid knowledge of electronic components, semiconductors, and the electronics supply chain.- Experience working with OEMs, ODMs, EMS providers, electronics manufacturers, or industrial customers.- Familiarity with RFQs, BOM analysis, component sourcing, pricing negotiations, and customer project management.- An established customer network within the German or European electronics industry is highly desirable.- Experience working with electronic component distributors, semiconductor manufacturers, or international technology partners is an advantage.Additional Technical Expertise – Preferred- Knowledge of IoT technologies, embedded systems, or industrial networking.- Familiarity with industrial Ethernet switches, routers, and industrial communication solutions.- Understanding of wireless and cellular technologies, including 4G, 5G, LTE-M, and NB-IoT.- Experience with IoT devices, asset tracking, sensors, or wireless communication modules.- Experience in technical product management, design-in projects, or customized electronic solutions.Experience in IoT and industrial networking is considered a strong advantage but is not mandatory. Proven electronic component sales experience and customer development capabilities remain the primary selection criteria.Personal Skills- Strong sales orientation, commercial awareness, and negotiation skills.- Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive and results-driven approach.- Ability to work independently and manage multiple customers and projects.- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.- Customer-focused attitude and willingness to develop long-term business partnerships.- Ability to collaborate effectively with international customers, suppliers, and engineering teams.- Willingness to travel for customer meetings, trade shows, and occasional international business trips.Language Requirements- German: Native-level proficiency, both written and spoken.- English: Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken.- Additional Languages: Proficiency in other European languages is considered a strong advantage.- Chinese language skills are an advantage but not mandatory.What We Offer- A challenging and rewarding role combining technical sales, business development, and product management.- The opportunity to expand our electronic components business and develop new markets for IoT and industrial networking solutions.- An international business environment with access to manufacturers, suppliers, and technology partners.- Direct collaboration with company management and short decision-making processes.- A high degree of autonomy and the opportunity to shape new business activities.- Flexible working arrangements and remote work options by agreement.- Competitive base salary with performance-based incentives, subject to agreement.- Long-term professional development opportunities and potential for expanded responsibilities.How to ApplyAre you an experienced sales professional in the electronics industry with strong customer relationships and a passion for developing new business opportunities? Would you like to combine your expertise in electronic components with innovative IoT and industrial networking technologies? Join Virtue Intelligence GmbH and help us expand our business across Germany and Europe.Please submit your CV, earliest possible starting date, and salary expectations to:Virtue Intelligence GmbHDarmstadt, GermanyEmail: web@virtue-intelligence.deWebsite: https://virtue-intelligence.com/Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Produktmanagement, Reklamationsbearbeitung, E-Commerce, E-BusinessExpertenkenntnisse: Pre-Sales-ServiceZwingend erforderlich: Außendienst, Vertrieb, Präsentation

Its premium portfolio encompasses car, truck, bus, two-wheel, and specialty tires as well as smart solutions and services for fleets and tire retailers. Continental has been delivering top performance for more than 150 years and is one of the world’s largest tire manufacturers. In fiscal 2025, the Tires group sector generated sales of 13.8 billion euros. Continental's tire division currently employs around 53,000 people worldwide and has 19 production and 16 development sites.Job DescriptionJoin us in shaping the future of Production and Industrial EngineeringAt our Industrial Engineering department in Hannover-Stöcken, we create sustainable value by driving efficiency, organizational and digital transformation in Production. Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and food service platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to consultation, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions with a targeted deal close of mid-2027. Public Affairs & Reputation Manager Germany (d/f/m)ABOUT THE JOBYou will lead the Corporate Affairs agenda in Germany, protecting and enhancing the reputation of the business through public affairs, trade association work, stakeholder engagement and issues management. You will help the business grow and move through its transformation by making sure policymakers, industry bodies, media and other key stakeholders understand our positions on the food topics that matter most, from nutrition to packaging.You will be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters. Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Develop and implement the German Corporate Affairs strategy for Foods, aligned to business priorities and the global Corporate Affairs direction. - Partner with the German Foods leadership team to spot external risks and opportunities early, so that Corporate Affairs shapes business decisions from the start. - With support from European Corporate Affairs, build and maintain relationships with policymakers, trade associations, media, and other key stakeholders. Represent Foods in relevant forums and committees and advance our advocacy on priority issues such as supply chain fairness, nutrition and reformulation, sustainability and packaging, innovation and responsible marketing. - Monitor political, regulatory and stakeholder developments and assess implications for Foods and its reputation. - Lead local issues management, crisis preparedness and reputation protection, so that emerging risks are identified and managed effectively. - Be a trusted advisor to business leaders on stakeholder engagement, communications and external positioning. - With support from Global Media Relations, manage media enquiries with timely, accurate and aligned responses that protect and strengthen Foods' reputation. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Significant experience (typically 7+ years) in corporate affairs, public affairs or communications, gained in a company, trade association, agency, political office or newsroom. - Strong understanding of the German political, policy, regulatory and trade association landscape, ideally with experience in food, nutrition, consumer or sustainability issues. - Proven ability to represent business positions externally and work through trade associations to shape credible, evidence-based policy engagement. - Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and relationship-building skills, with with the ability to build strong external networks. - Excellent written and spoken German and English, with strong presentation and writing skills. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience managing reputation, stakeholder engagement and communications within a complex organization; experience working through business transformation is a plus. - Calm, sound judgement under pressure and on sensitive issues. - Confidence with digital tools, including AI-supported monitoring and content, used responsibly.  WHAT WE OFFER YOU:- flexible hours and the option for remote work- 30 days of vacation plus December 24th and 31st off- Meal allowance: €65 per month- Access to Manager Check‑Ups – Optional executive‑level health screenings to support long‑term well‑being and performance- Company pension & shares- In-house café: snacks, lunch, and coffee specialties at discounted prices- ·Discounts via Corporate Benefits- Deutschland Ticket: €50 monthly subsidy or a discounted company bike- Free training opportunities and access to our own learning platform- E-GYM/Wellpass for €20 per month & free corporate health management & a 24/7 counseling service- And the best for last – unlimited ice cream!ARE YOU INTERESTED?Great! We look forward to receiving your application online. Please note that applications submitted by email cannot be considered.Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.

The (Sr.) Quality Lab Engineer in this role is responsible for designing and maintaining product reliability test methods, equipment and related peripherals, whether developed in-house or procured externally. New developments will be carried out in close collaboration with product qualification engineering and R&D to ensure that product qualification objectives are met within the defined specifications.What you will do- As a (Sr.) Quality Lab Engineer, you will define reliability test systems, lead the development of required electronic boards, perform electrical and reliability testing, optimize test methods, train operational staff, and oversee after‑care activities such as service and maintenance.- You will review the test requirements and set up the test environment, including the necessary circuitry, to carry out lifetime stress testing such as DHTOL for product qualification.- As a work‑package or project owner, you will lead technical alignment with suppliers, manage risks, track schedule, quality, cost and prepare progress reports for stakeholders.- You will ensure that test equipment complies with relevant standards, meets health and safety requirements, and remains user‑friendly and fully operational for technical staff- You will provide and maintain up to date documentation (working instructions, manuals, etc.)- You will participate in continuous improvement studies, FMEA, calibrations, and related activities supporting quality work.What you will need- Master’s degree in Science, Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline- Understanding of measurement parameters and test equipment used for characterization and reliability test of SiC and GaN devices- Experience in reliability test methods like HTRB, H3TRB, HTGB, DHTOL (preferred)- Experience in analogue and digital circuit design- Software Programming skills (C, python, LabVIEW, or similar)- Strong communication skills and attitude to bring things forward- Great attention to details and analytical thinking seeing the whole- Focused on goal and target driven- Understanding of industry quality standards AEC-Q101- Strong team player, willing to learn and share the knowledge- Standard Office Tools- High quality mindset- German/English fluent spoken and written

As an Equipment & Test Engineer, you will take technical ownership of equipment used for the qualification and reliability testing of power semiconductor devices, particularly SiC MOSFETs. Working closely with Product Qualification Engineering, R&D and suppliers you will maintain and improve existing equipment while developing new test and automation solutions. This multidisciplinary and hands-on role combines equipment engineering, measurement technology, electronics development, software, and test automation.What you will do- Manage laboratory and reliability test equipment throughout its lifecycle, including acquisition, commissioning, operation, maintenance, calibration, upgrades, and decommissioning- Ensure equipment availability and performance through systematic troubleshooting, supplier coordination, and monitoring of relevant KPIs such as downtime, calibration status, issue resolution, and measurement stability- Prepare, execute, and improve electrical and thermal reliability tests in coordination with Product Qualification Engineers, including the analysis of test conditions, equipment limitations, and measurement results- Develop and improve electronic circuits, control boards, interfaces, fixtures, embedded systems, and automated test solutions- Troubleshoot complete systems across hardware, firmware, communication interfaces, host software, and graphical user interfaces- Lead technical work packages from requirements and supplier selection through installation, verification, validation, and release- Apply laboratory best practices regarding safety, usability, standardization, traceability, documentation, and continuous improvement- Create and maintain manuals, working instructions, risk assessments, test procedures, and technical reports- Maintain and improve laboratory asset management, including equipment tracking, barcode verification, and dashboard reporting- Support user training, FMEA, and the standardization of test processesWhat you will need- A degree in electronical engineering or a comparable technical discipline- Relevant experience in test engineering, electronics development, automation, or a similar technical environment- A strong hands-on mentality and the motivation to build, wire, commission, measure, troubleshoot, and improve technical systems- Good knowledge of electronic circuits, measurement technology, laboratory equipment, and systematic fault analysis- Practical experience with oscilloscopes, data-acquisition systems, programmable power supplies, function generators, or similar laboratory instruments- The ability to understand complete systems across hardware, firmware, communication, and software- Experience in reading, creating, or modifying electronic schematics- Basic programming knowledge and the willingness to work with existing firmware, software, and automated test applications- A structured and analytical working style with a strong quality, safety, and documentation mindset- Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to independently drive technical work packages- German/English spoken and writtenWhat would be an advantage- Knowledge of discrete power semiconductors, particularly SiC MOSFETs- Experience with qualification or reliability tests such as HTRB, H3TRB, PCT, DGS, IOL, TDDB, or thermal-resistance measurements- Experience with KiCad, Altium Designer, or comparable electronic design tools- Programming knowledge in Python, C/C++, LabVIEW, Visual You will turn customer requirements and performance insights into practical improvements, bringing colleagues and customers together to deliver results across internal markets.Be the connection that brings customer, commercial, operations and IT together....As the strategic link between the customer and DSV, you oversee performance, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure that commercial agreements become effective and scalable logistics solutions. You will have the freedom to influence solutions, challenge constructively and help shape both the customer experience and DSV’s performance.What you bring:You combine strong customer focus with commercial awareness and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.We are looking for someone with:- Several years (5-10 years) of relevant experience in transport, logistics, supply chain, customer solutions, account management, or contract management- Strong knowledge of Road Freight operations and international transport networks- Experience managing strategic customer relationships or portfolios- The ability to influence stakeholders at different organisational levels- Strong analytical skills and confidence working with KPIs, performance metrics and operational data- Experience driving continuous improvement- A solution-oriented mindset with the confidence to challenge constructively- Strong Excel and data interpretation capabilities- Excellent communication skills in English.Ready to shape what’s next?If you want to take ownership of strategic customer partnerships and turn insights into operational and commercial impact, we would like to hear from you.The position can be based in Germany, the Netherlands or Poland.Your Contact:David MillerP&O Talent Acquisition Partnerkarriere@de.dsv.comPlease apply with your complete application documents via Employee Central.Please submit your complete application documents. Wir bewegen Karrieren, Ambitionen und Chancen.Mit rund 150.000 Kolleg:innen in über 90 Ländern sind wir weltweit führend in der Transport- und Logistikbranche.
